title: Arda Anarchy
description: Semi-Anarchy, Multiple Gamemodes, PvP, PvE, Vanilla, Vanilla+
body:
Arda Anarchy is a network with multiple gamemodes: Arda (Vanilla+, semi-anarchy, events) and VanillEä (pure-vanilla, PvP, cosmetics-only).

1) Arda Anarchy (Vanilla +)
- Middle-earth themed: drop-inventory, no claims, no resets.,
- Clans, raids, boss/Tower events, wild loot, dungeons, quests, custom items,

2) VanillEä (Pure Vanilla)
- Classic vanilla survival: PvP on, no land claims, no custom items.,
- Cosmetics only; lightweight clan chat/tags,

Performance (both servers)
- 32 Chunk Render Distance,
- Vanilla Mob Spawn Rates,
- No artificial limits on farms, entities, or builds,
- Built to handle megabases, mob grinders, and massive redstone setups
